summary: Parked kerb backing onto university buildings; nearest home is 59 m away.
reasons: Backs onto university buildings and car park
Cars park along the first 25 m

drivers.seclusion: Kerb faces university buildings and a car park; the nearest dwelling is 59 m away and the other side is bush and a college block.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed through road with a few cars parked on the north kerb; a van fits beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road, moderate by day; the university side is quiet overnight.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; signs ban parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm only, so nights are open.

flags: No Parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm: leave before 7am on weekdays
No Stopping Any Time signs near the stretch ends, so stay mid-stretch
Road noise from a through route
sun_shade: Open to the north side; bush canopy shades the south side and the 40-77 m end.
cannot_judge: Exactly where the No Stopping zones start

best_section.where: Upland Road north kerb, in front of the university car park
